kyc.title: Tiered verification
kyc.intro: To play with euros the law requires verifying your identity. It's tiered: only what's needed, only when needed.
kyc.l0.title: Level 0 · Explore
kyc.l1.title: Level 1 · Account
kyc.l2.title: Level 2 · Euros
kyc.l2.need: Name, ID number and date of birth
kyc.l2.unlock: Add funds and enter euro porras
kyc.l3.title: Level 3 · Withdrawals
kyc.l3.need: Document + bank account in your name
kyc.why: The law requires it to play with euros. Takes about 2 minutes.
kyc.off: Verification turns on when the licensed operator is connected.
kyc.form.title: Verification · Level {n}
kyc.form.name: Full name
kyc.form.docHint: Photo of your ID, both sides.
kyc.form.review: Verification sent. The licensed operator will review it and we'll let you know.
kyc.form.demoNote: Process preview: for now the data isn't stored or verified.
